headline: Heard tax relief requests for properties at 131 Main Street, 131 Church Street, and other addresses, including late fees and back taxes.
summary: Petitioners asked for a late fee to be waived, hardship help on 2026 taxes, and penalties and interest caused by a property manager's error. One petitioner asked for multiple years of back taxes to be abated before a planned city tax sale.
plain_text:
Tax Abatement Committee  
Friday, October, 3, 2025, 9:00 a.m. 
Sharon Bushor Conference Rm 
 
Minutes of the Organizational Meeting 
 
 
Committee Members: Councilors Carter Neubieser (CB) Chair; Buddy Singh (BS), 
Evan Litwin (EL) 
 
Others Present: Jessica Brown (JB), City Attorney’s Office; Katherine Schad (KS), 
Interim City Assessor; Haley McClenahan (HM), Assistant City Attorney; Kenneth 
Nosek (KN), Committee Administrator-City Assessor’s Office; Jared Rogers, City 
Assessor’s Office; Traci Isham (TI) Revenue Operations Manager; Shaunie Farmer 
(SF), Accounts Receivable Coordinator 
 
Petitioners Present: Delia Properties LLC; Fadil Hajrovic; Paul Leclair; Aviva Ratzer, 
works on financial side for 234 SNA LLC,   Sehara Rubin  also for 234 SNA LLC – 
Joey Goldzal came late to Zoom.   
 
Petitioners Not Present: Garrett Workman; Peter Fisk 
 
  
At 5:05 p.m. Carter Neubieser Chair commenced the hearing. 
 
Move to adopt Agenda as on Civic Clerk (EL) Second (BS)  
Public Forum – no one from the public here to speak. No one online 
Moved to item three – hearing overview. 
Swearing in of all Petitioners and those providing evidence. 
 
HAJROVIC, 58 VALADE ROAD, PIC# 024-1-078-058: Petitioner requests abatement of late fee and penalty 
amount applied when his taxes were paid late. Attended hearing in person. 
 
LECLAIR & 120 HYDE STREET LLC, 54 SPRUCE STREET, PID# 049-4-082-000 and 29-33 SOUTH WILLARD 
STREET, PID# 045-2-252-000 and 120 HYDE STREET, PID# 040-2-041-000: Petitioner requests abatement 
due to hardship – owner of record has died and the properties are not producing enough income to pay 
for themselves. Attended hearing in person. 
 
DELIA PROPERTIES LLC, 131 MAIN STREET, Unit C-1, PID# 049-3-095-005: Petitioner requests hardship 
assistance for approximately 30% of the 2026 taxes due. Attended hearing in person.
234 SNA LLC, 131 CHURCH STREET, PID# 049-3-115-000: Petitioner requests abatement of penalties and 
interest and other that arose in 2025 and 2026 due to an administrative breakdown originating with the 
professional property management company that 234 SNA LLC had retained to handle the property’s 
administration. Attended hearing via Zoom. 
 
WORKMAN, 120 LORI LANE, PID# 025-1-039-000: Petitioner requests refund for taxes paid on a 
structure that was demolished before the purchase of property by himself. However, current owner did 
not confirm record during grievance hearings in previous years nor alert office of assessor that property 
record was inconsistent with what was purchased. Did not attend hearing. 
 
FISK, 52 LOALDO DRIVE, PID# 028-1-010-000: Petitioner requests multiple years of back taxes be abated 
due to medical problems. This requests comes on the cusp of impending tax sale by the city. Did not 
attend hearing. 
 
Adjourn 8:13 p.m.
